model: Raven Twin Mk3 with S+S tandem with Rohloff
description: A New Thorn Raven Twin Tandem with S+S couplings for ease of separation for storage or transporation . The bikes front third separates . Tandem with S+S - Size Medium /Medium -in Gunmetal , this is a universal size and would be suitable for a lot of Tandem crews . Details: This is a universal size and would be suitable for a lot of Tandem crews . This tandem bike would be ideal for day rides , weekend trips away , Tandem club runs or even cycle touring and camping. This Tandem comes with a three brakes option which is recommended for a Tandem riding , especially in hilly terrain . If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk.
